# ZecBooks

> View-only books for shielded Zcash. A free Mac app (MIT license) for a person and their accountant, and a zecbooks command for exchanges and custodians on Windows, Linux and macOS. It classifies income, change, expense and fees, then hands a reviewer a locked, expiring file. It cannot spend.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://zecbooks.app): what ZecBooks does and download
- [For exchanges and custodians](https://zecbooks.app/institutions/): the zecbooks command
- [Privacy](https://zecbooks.app/privacy/): what stays on your Mac

## Guides
- [All guides](https://zecbooks.app/guides/)
- [What Is a Zcash Viewing Key? UFVK vs UIVK vs Seed](https://zecbooks.app/guides/what-is-a-viewing-key/): A Zcash viewing key can see shielded activity but cannot spend. How full and incoming viewing keys differ from recovery words, and which ZecBooks accepts.
- [How to Export a Zcash Viewing Key (UFVK) From Zashi](https://zecbooks.app/guides/export-ufvk-from-zashi/): Export a view-only unified full viewing key from Zashi or Zodl and import it into ZecBooks on your Mac. Never move your recovery words.
- [How to Build a Locked Zcash Tax Package for Your Accountant](https://zecbooks.app/guides/build-a-proof-pack/): Classify income, change, expense and fees, pick the rows, set an expiry date and export a locked file for your accountant. It holds no keys.
- [How to Share Zcash Books With Your Accountant Safely](https://zecbooks.app/guides/share-proof-pack-safely/): Send your accountant a locked, expiring ZecBooks file instead of your viewing key or recovery words. What to send, what never to send, and what expiry does.
- [Locked Tax Package vs CSV and PDF: What to Send](https://zecbooks.app/guides/proof-pack-vs-csv/): When to send a locked, expiring ZecBooks tax package and when a plain CSV or PDF export is enough. CSV and PDF files never expire.
- [How to Open a ZecBooks Tax Package (for Accountants)](https://zecbooks.app/guides/open-proof-pack-reader/): Got a .sanebooks file from a client? Open it in ZecBooks for Mac with the passphrase they gave you. No viewing key, no sync and no account needed.
